name: Payment Facilitator, High-Risk Merchant and Transaction Laundering
description: Unauthorised or concealed merchants route card or bank payments through another merchant's account (transaction laundering) or use payment facilitators with weak sub-merchant oversight. This disguises illegal or high-risk goods and moves funds from fraud, gambling or illicit trade into the legitimate system.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Prepaid Cards, Mobile Payments and Internet-Based Payment Services (2013)
Card scheme rules on merchant and payment facilitator monitoring (general reference)

indicators.name: Transaction descriptors or products inconsistent with registered business
indicators.canon: Transaction descriptors or products inconsistent with registered business
indicators.desc: Card data show goods or services unrelated to the merchant's declared activity or website.
indicators.ctx: Card data show goods or services unrelated to the merchant's declared activity or website.

indicators.name: Unusual ticket sizes or round amounts
indicators.desc: Transactions are repeatedly in round or unusually uniform amounts that do not fit the stated purpose.
indicators.ctx: Average ticket differs sharply from the merchant category or is repetitive and rounded.

indicators.name: High chargeback and refund ratios
indicators.desc: Unusual refund or chargeback volumes or cycles relative to sales.
indicators.ctx: Chargebacks or refunds exceed scheme thresholds or peer averages.

indicators.name: Sub-merchants sharing owners, devices or bank accounts
indicators.desc: Several apparently separate businesses or sub-accounts share owners, signatories, addresses, devices or bank accounts.
indicators.ctx: Many sub-merchants link to the same individuals or accounts.

indicators.name: Website content differs from the underwriting file
indicators.canon: Website content differs from the underwriting file
indicators.desc: Live site sells restricted products, redirects or has cloned or hidden pages.
indicators.ctx: Live site sells restricted products, redirects or has cloned or hidden pages.

indicators.name: Rapid cash-out of settlements to third-party accounts
indicators.canon: Rapid cash-out of settlements to third-party accounts
indicators.desc: Settlement funds are sent immediately to unrelated accounts, often offshore.
indicators.ctx: Settlement funds are sent immediately to unrelated accounts, often offshore.

indicators.name: Traffic spikes outside merchant geography
indicators.canon: Payments or activity in jurisdictions unrelated to the customer's business or goods
indicators.desc: Payments, counterparties or sales originate in or go to countries with no link to the customer, declared business, services or goods.
indicators.ctx: Sales volume arises from countries unrelated to the merchant's market.

indicators.name: Card-not-present volume with testing patterns
indicators.desc: Many small authorisations from varied cards, consistent with card testing then fraud.
indicators.ctx: Many small authorisations from varied cards, consistent with card testing then fraud.

indicators.name: Payment facilitator onboarding lacks beneficial-owner data
indicators.canon: Payment facilitator onboarding lacks beneficial-owner data
indicators.desc: Sub-merchants onboarded without full ownership or identity checks.
indicators.ctx: Sub-merchants onboarded without full ownership or identity checks.

indicators.name: Use of multiple shell merchant accounts to spread volume
indicators.canon: Use of multiple shell merchant accounts to spread volume
indicators.desc: Volumes distributed across many accounts to stay below monitoring thresholds.
indicators.ctx: Volumes distributed across many accounts to stay below monitoring thresholds.
